summary.tldr: Creates a temporary GST/HST holiday on certain taxable supplies from December 14, 2024 to February 15, 2025.
what_it_does: Amends the Excise Tax Act to remove GST/HST for a temporary period on certain taxable supplies, from December 14, 2024 to February 15, 2025.
summary.background: The bill was introduced in the House of Commons on November 27, 2024 and received first reading.
